description.value: Stone Cottage Gallery is a working artist's studio and gallery in Qualicum Beach showcasing wildlife sculptures and carvings by award-winning Canadian artist Del C. Mark, who brings over 50 years of outdoor experience to lifelike depictions of BC wildlife in soapstone, alabaster, and antler. Subjects range from black bears and orca whales to herons and jumping salmon, carved from materials including Brazilian Soapstone and African Wonderstone. Located just a short distance from uptown Qualicum Beach, it offers cycling tourists a distinctive glimpse into fine craft art rooted in the natural world of Vancouver Island.
